target_claim: In case (2) (some x is related by R to two distinct y_1 != y_2), the proof asserts that neither {y_1} nor {y_2} can lie in the range of R^-> , and concludes from this that R^-> cannot be a surjection.
source_quote: For the second, it can be seen that neither $\set {y_1}$ nor $\set {y_2}$ can be in $\Rng {\map {\RR^\to} {\powerset S} }$.
